data.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
data.detailed_description:
Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

Build your construction empire and expand your vehicle fleet to take on challenging construction contracts in and around Maienstein, a location inspired by idyllic German landscapes. Prepare yourself to master huge construction sites and satisfy your clients’ needs. Coordinate extensive tasks as you grow to become the biggest builder in town!

Prepare yourself to master huge construction sites and satisfy your clients’ needs. Join forces with your friends in multiplayer and coordinate extensive tasks as you grow to become the biggest builder in town!

Construction Simulator: Evolution features a varied and ample vehicle fleet. Excavators, wheel loaders, cranes, dumper trucks, asphalt compactors, and demolition machines – we got you covered if you are excited to control the latest machinery in the construction industry from renowned manufacturers such as Caterpillar®, CIFA, JCB, Kenworth, Liebherr, SANY, and others.

In addition to these well-known brands from previous installments, Construction Simulator: Evolution welcomes a host of new, globally esteemed manufacturers, and pushes the licensor pool to a whole new level for the franchise. This time, you can also look forward to heavy construction machinery from Ammann, Sennebogen, Volvo Construction Equipment, and many more. All in all, around 80 officially licensed construction machines from a wide range of world-famous brands are ready to prove their power and reliability on the construction site.

In addition, you will also have more choices when it comes to your workwear. Licensed outfits by Bobcat and Strauss will turn every construction site into a catwalk – looking cool and feeling safe. The Character Editor lets you customize your construction worker to your liking by choosing workwear and safety equipment, adjusting colors, and more.

For the first time in the Construction Simulator series, you will not only be able to build but also to demolish with raw power! Use hydraulic hammers and specialized machinery to clear space for new construction projects. But beware: demolition always comes with new challenges. Thanks to realistic destruction physics and a variety of tools, you decide how a building comes crashing down.

At the same time, Construction Simulator: Evolution lets you get hands-on: plaster walls, operate hand tools such as a jackhammer, shovel, nail gun, and more. This exciting combination delivers a highly realistic construction site experience never seen before in the franchise, putting you at the center of every contract. 

Ready to lay the foundation of your construction empire and rise to the top? Put on your construction helmet and start building your legacy today with Construction Simulator: Evolution!

GET TO WORK.

Features:

EXTENSIVE FLEET: 80+ construction machines and attachments

REAL-LIFE BRANDS: Plenty of globally recognized manufacturers

NEW LICENSORS: Ammann, Epiroc, Sennebogen, Volvo Construction Equipment, and many more

MANY CONTRACTS: A wide range of challenging construction and demolition jobs

NEW FEATURES: Demolition and manual labor for the first time in the series

CUSTOMIZATION: Character Editor with workwear from Bobcat and Strauss

EXPLORE MAIENSTEIN: Discover a European map inspired by idyllic German landscapes, featuring its own extensive campaign and story

PERIPHERALS: Support for popular gamepads and steering wheels
